title: Medical Freeze of a Resort Club Membership — Member Services Guidance
content:
A Resort Club Memberships membership may be frozen for medical reasons at a level where a medical freeze is available. A freeze takes effect only on a medical freeze notice the member has signed.

## The rule the desk applies

- **Signed notice.** The freeze rests on a medical freeze notice for the membership whose status on the membership's notice records is signed. A medical freeze notice awaiting signature, or one withdrawn, does not bring a freeze into effect.
- **From an active membership.** The freeze takes an active membership to the status frozen.
- **Start.** The freeze starts on the first day of the next billing period where the level's schedule says a freeze always starts then.
- **Length.** A freeze lasts whole months, at least the level's fewest months of one freeze.
- **Yearly limit.** The frozen months of a membership year, counted including the new freeze, may not exceed the level's most frozen months per membership year. The frozen months already counted in a membership year are the freeze fee entries on the account whose dues period falls in the current membership year; the membership year runs from the start date's month and day each year.
- **Billing while frozen.** Each frozen month is billed the level's fee per frozen month instead of dues. A freeze fee is billed only for a membership whose status is frozen.
- **Use while frozen.** Guest passes and benefits cannot be used while frozen.
- **Minimum term.** The minimum term is extended by the frozen months.
- **End of the freeze.** At the end of the freeze the membership becomes active and dues resume.

## Yearly limit worked through (hypothetical)

At a level whose most frozen months per membership year is 3:

| Freeze fee entries already in the current membership year | Months of the new freeze | Frozen months counted including the new freeze | Within the limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 3 | 3 | Yes |
| 2 | 1 | 3 | Yes |
| 2 | 2 | 4 | No, 4 exceeds 3 |
| 3 | 1 | 4 | No, 4 exceeds 3 |

Freeze fee entries dated in an earlier membership year are not counted in the current one.

## Starting date (hypothetical)

At a level whose billing period begins on the first of the month, a medical freeze notice the member signs on any day in June takes effect at the start of the next billing period: the freeze starts on 1 July.

## Points of judgement

- **A freeze of part of a month:** a freeze lasts whole months.
- **A freeze fee on a membership that is active:** not billed; a freeze fee is billed only while the status is frozen.
- **A member who asks to bring a guest while frozen:** guest passes cannot be used while the membership is frozen.
